note:
Wooded family campground between New Lisbon and Necedah with a spring-fed swim and catch-and-release pond, near Castle Rock Lake.
Mostly seasonal: about 12 of its roughly 71 sites (10 RV, 2 tent) are sold by the night. --Claude
summary: Operator site read: 2027 rates $30-47 (peak weekend $47; holidays $50 with 3-night min) - passes the $50 gate; ResNexus booking; 30 A + water, no sewer. Map legend: 10 daily RV + 2 daily tent sites vs ~59 seasonal (~17% nightly) -> kept with mostly-seasonal caveat. Google 4.1 (73). Not waterfront kept (Little Yellow River is a few-m stream ~100 m+ off in woods). Season 2027 May 1-Oct 18.
flags: LONG-STAY: map legend 'Daily RV/Tent Site' marks only RV sites 11, 13, 22, 23, 69, 71, 87, 88, 89, 90 and tent sites 101, 102 (12) against ~59 'Seasonal Site' - ~17% nightly. Passes tests (posted nightly rate, booking site, >1 in 10 nightly); note carries the mostly-seasonal line. No discouraging wording found. Google 4.1 (73).
PRICE GATE: passes - ordinary summer RV rate $38 weekday / $47 weekend (2027); only holiday weekends reach $50.
MIN STAY: 3 nights on holiday weekends only (not standing).

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. The 'Little Yellow River' bordering the property is a meandering stream a few metres wide (well under 30 m: creekside at most) in wooded marsh ~100 m+ north-east of the nearest (seasonal) sites 1-5 and 17-18; no daily site is near it. The stored evidence ('only a small pond ~600m south') is wrong: the spring-fed swim pond (~40 m) sits inside the campground (~43.9355,-90.1053). Suggested evidence: 'map + NAIP 2026-11-16: Little Yellow River a few-m stream ~100 m+ beyond seasonal sites under woods; on-site swim pond is a ~40 m dug pond; daily sites 11-90 nowhere near water'.
SITES: stored count 85 has no source; the operator map shows ~71 numbered sites (69 RV + tent 101-102). Count left unset.
SEASON: 2027 overnight season May 1-Oct 18 (written); seasonal-site season is May 1-Oct 15.
OHV: 'ATV-friendly areas and trail access nearby' - general campground, stays.
PIN 43.9339,-90.1035 is on the entrance road near State Road 80; the site loops spread ~100-300 m west and north-west (centre ~43.9348,-90.1059). Left (under 250 m).
